attchmntText: California Software Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: California Software Company Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, during a board meeting on November 14, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 88.06 lakhs for the half year, compared to 22.82 lakhs in the same period last year. Earnings per share stood at 0.14 for the half year. Revenue from operations was 292.16 lakhs. The standalone balance sheet shows total assets of 6,802.68 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. Receivables of 20.00 Crores from Ryuklabs have been converted into an investment in I Agent. The investment in the subsidiary company is reported at 311.38 lakhs. Current tax balance of 380.02 lakhs is subject to reconciliation. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board.
